The '''LPL 2017 Summer''' split was the second split of the [[LoL Pro League]] (''LPL'') season, held in Shanghai and organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 8 June to 1 September 2017. Twelve teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}} Group Stage followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket. [[JD Gaming]] entered the league after acquiring the slot of [[Qiao Gu Reapers]], while the remaining teams either continued from Spring or qualified through the [[LPL/2017/Summer/Promotion|2017 Spring Promotion]]. Championship Points awarded during the split contributed toward qualification for the 2017 Regional Finals and the [[World Championship/2017|2017 World Championship]].

{{ShowBracket|id=XZH7XF5XEJ}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** 2 groups of 6 teams each.
** Each team plays 16 matches.
*** Double Round Robin within own group
*** Single Round Robin against other group
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place of each group''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place of each group''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs, and will start the series with a 1-game advantage.
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th and 6th place of each group''}} qualify for [[LPL/2018/Spring|Spring split]]
* '''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}}
* Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2017|Mid-Season Invitational 2017]]
